description:
China's wealthy thought they could protect their money by moving it overseas. Now the Chinese Communist Party is making sure they can't escape. In this episode of China Uncensored, we look at China's new exit regulations, the CCP's crackdown on private wealth, and why these changes could mark the end of Chinese entrepreneurship as we know it.
